2010.title: Part B 图表作文：手机用户量增长情况对比
2010.apply_en:
The bar chart shows that the mobile-phone subscription numbers associated with the two groups rose steadily during the periods presented. Subscriptions in developing countries climbed from 0.5 billion in 2000 to 4 billion in 2008, while those in developed countries rose from 0.7 billion to 1 billion over the same span. Although the two moved in the same direction, the pace of growth differed sharply.

The gap stems from the different market conditions of the two groups. In developing countries, the mobile-phone market had not yet reached saturation, and given the enormous population, the number of potential customers was huge. Thanks to the economic boom, an increasing number of them gradually joined the market. In developed countries, by contrast, a saturated market left little room for further growth.

For this trend to continue exerting a positive influence on everyday life, concerted efforts from all sectors of society are essential. Relevant authorities should provide the necessary support and create favorable conditions under which mobile services can play a constructive role. Individuals should also make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances.
2010.apply_cn:
该柱状图表明，两组对象的手机订阅量在相应时期内均持续上升。发展中国家的订阅量从 2000 年的 5 亿攀升至 2008 年的 40 亿，而发达国家同期从 7 亿增至 10 亿。二者虽同向变动，但增速差异明显。

这一差距源于两组市场环境的差异。发展中国家的手机市场尚未饱和，加之人口基数庞大，潜在客户数量巨大；得益于经济腾飞，越来越多的人陆续进入市场。相比之下，发达国家市场已经饱和，几乎没有进一步增长的空间。

要使这一趋势持续为日常生活带来积极影响，需要社会各方共同努力。有关部门应提供必要支持，为移动服务发挥作用创造良好条件。个人也应结合自身情况作出理性选择。
tips: 图型：柱状（bar），两事物同向不同速——首句用 rose steadily，**不要**用 did not move in a uniform direction（那是给有升有降的图准备的）。
两个上升各用 climbed / rose 换词，末句用 the pace of growth differed sharply 点出"速度不同"，这是本题的题眼。
第二段用经济类模板，把 生活便利 换成 手机普及 语境（spread of mobile phones）。
数据只需首末两年，不必逐年罗列，控制字数在 150 词左右。

key_phrases.en: rose steadily during the periods presented
key_phrases.cn: 在相应时期内持续上升

key_phrases.en: climbed from … to …
the pace of growth differed sharply
had not yet reached saturation
left little room for further growth
key_phrases.cn: 几乎没有进一步增长的空间

2011.title: Part B 图表作文：汽车品牌市场份额变化
2011.apply_en:
The bar chart shows that the market shares associated with the three auto brands did not move in a uniform direction during the periods presented. Chinese brands climbed from a modest share to the leading position, while Japanese brands fell by nearly 10 percentage points and lost their top place. By contrast, American brands held steady, with only a slight increase.

The shift is not unexpected. On the one hand, Chinese auto producers have narrowed the technology gap between themselves and foreign competitors and have cleverly adjusted their promotion strategies. On the other hand, as the national economy grows, consumers increasingly favour products that suit their own needs and budgets.

For domestic brands to hold their advantage, continued efforts are essential. Manufacturers should keep improving quality and after-sales service, while consumers should make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances.
2011.apply_cn:
该柱状图表明，三个汽车品牌的市场份额在相应时期内并未朝着相同方向变化。国产品牌从一个不大的份额攀升至领先地位，日系品牌则下降近 10 个百分点、失去头名位置。相比之下，美系品牌保持稳定，仅略有增长。

这一变化并不意外。一方面，中国汽车制造商缩小了与外国竞争者的技术差距，并灵活调整了营销策略；另一方面，随着国民经济发展，消费者越来越青睐契合自身需求与预算的产品。

国产品牌若要保持优势，仍需持续努力。厂商应不断提升质量与售后服务，消费者也应结合自身情况作出理性选择。
tips: 本题是**有升有降**的典型：首句务必用 did not move in a uniform direction。
三事物分组写法：升的（国产）→ 降的（日系）→ 持平的（美系，By contrast 引出），与静态模板的"分组"思路一致。
第二段套经济类模板，把"经济发展"落到"技术差距缩小 + 营销策略"，即原文的两条因果。
注意份额用 percentage points（百分点），不要与 percent 混用。

key_phrases.en: did not move in a uniform direction
key_phrases.cn: 并未朝着相同方向变化

key_phrases.en: were displaced from their leading position
expanded their share by nearly the same margin
narrowed the technology gap
By contrast
key_phrases.cn: 相比之下（用于转折对比）

2012.title: Part B 图表作文：某公司员工工作满意度调查
2012.apply_en:
The table presents an uneven distribution among the age groups associated with job satisfaction. Employees above 50 account for the largest share of satisfaction, at 40%. The middle group, those aged 41 to 50, represents the lowest level, with none of them satisfied and 64% expressing dissatisfaction. In contrast, employees aged 40 or younger make up a relatively small proportion, only 16.7% of whom reported contentment.

The differences are closely related to the career situation of each group. The 41-to-50 group, less energetic than the younger crowd and less established than older professionals, often reaches a career plateau, and the consequent sense of powerlessness reduces them to deep dissatisfaction. Younger employees, by contrast, may still be adapting to their posts and are therefore cautious about declaring satisfaction.

For job satisfaction to improve, efforts from both employers and employees are essential. Employers should offer clearer promotion paths and timely feedback, while employees should make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances.
2012.apply_cn:
该表格呈现了各年龄段在工作满意度上的不均衡分布。50 岁以上员工满意度占比最大，达 40%。41 至 50 岁的中间组水平最低，无人满意，64% 表示不满。相比之下，40 岁及以下员工占比很小，仅 16.7% 表示满意。

这些差异与各群体的职业处境密切相关。41 至 50 岁组比年轻人精力不足、比年长者资历尚浅，往往进入职业平台期，随之而来的无力感使他们深感不满。相比之下，年轻员工可能仍在适应岗位，因而对表达满意较为谨慎。

要提升工作满意度，需要雇主与员工共同努力。雇主应提供更清晰的晋升通道与及时反馈，员工也应结合自身情况作出理性选择。
tips: 本题图表是**表格（table）**：首句把 chart 换成 This table，这是最容易失分的地方。
数据是"分组比高低"而非时间变化 → 用**静态**第一段模板（largest share / middle group / relatively small）。
41-50 岁组"无人满意 + 64% 不满"是本题最关键的对比，务必写出。
第二段可套校园类/经济类模板，落点写"职业平台期（career plateau）"。

key_phrases.en: The table presents an uneven distribution among…
key_phrases.cn: 该表格呈现了……之间的不均衡分布

key_phrases.en: account for the largest share, at …%
none of them felt satisfied
reach a career plateau
the consequent sense of powerlessness

2013.title: Part B 大作文：大学生兼职比例柱状图
2013.apply_en:
The bar chart shows that the proportion of college students taking part-time jobs rose steadily during the periods presented. The rate climbed from 67.77% in the first year to 88.24% in the final year, and the biggest increase occurred in the graduation year, when the figure was 16% higher than a year earlier.

The upward trend stems from students' growing wish to gain practical experience. Undoubtedly, the competitive job market has laid a solid foundation for this change. As the school years advance, students attach greater importance to career preparation and become increasingly willing to embrace real working environments. Consequently, part-time jobs have gradually become integrated into campus life, while their practical value has gained wider recognition.

For this trend to bring lasting benefits, efforts from both universities and students are essential. Universities should provide more internship channels, while students should strike a balance between work and study in light of their own circumstances.
2013.apply_cn:
该柱状图表明，大学生兼职比例在相应时期内持续上升。比例从大一的 67.77% 升至大四的 88.24%，其中增幅最大的是毕业那年，比上年高出 16%。

这一上升趋势源于学生获取实践经验意愿的增强。毫无疑问，竞争激烈的就业市场为这一变化奠定了坚实基础。随着年级升高，学生更加重视职业准备，也更愿意走进真实的工作环境。兼职因此逐渐融入校园生活，其实践价值也得到更多认可。

要使这一趋势带来长久收益，需要高校与学生共同努力。高校应提供更多实习渠道，学生也应结合自身情况平衡好学业与工作。
tips: 本题是**单事物持续上升**：直接写一条上升线，用 showing a steady upward trend 收尾，不必硬凑对比句。
"毕业年增幅最大"是题眼，用 the biggest increase occurred in … 单列一句。
第二段套经济类模板，把落点写成"就业竞争 + 职业准备"。
数字要原文照抄（67.77% / 88.24% / 16%），百分比精确到小数点。

key_phrases.en: rose steadily during the periods presented
key_phrases.cn: 在相应时期内持续上升

key_phrases.en: showing a steady upward trend
the biggest increase occurred in …
gain practical experience
strike a balance between work and study

2014.title: Part B 大作文：城市与乡村人口的变化
2014.apply_en:
The bar chart shows that the population figures associated with urban and rural areas did not move in a uniform direction from 1990 to 2010. The urban population climbed from 300 million to 670 million, while the rural population declined from 820 million to 680 million over the same span.

The narrowing gap results from the joint effects of urbanization and unequal economic opportunities. In the twenty years, urban sprawl transformed millions of peasants into city residents, and many more chose to leave their hometowns on their own initiative. Meanwhile, as urban living standards improved considerably, few economic opportunities fell on rural areas, which prompted the young to seek a better life in cities.

For urban and rural areas to develop in a balanced way, concerted efforts are essential. Relevant authorities should channel more resources into the countryside and create favorable conditions for local employment, so that rural residents can also benefit from national progress.
2014.apply_cn:
该柱状图表明，1990 至 2010 年间城乡人口数量并未朝着相同方向变化。城镇人口从 3 亿攀升至 6.7 亿，而农村人口在同一时期从 8.2 亿降至 6.8 亿。

差距的缩小源于城镇化与经济机会不均的共同作用。二十年间，城市扩张使数百万农民被动转为城镇居民，更多人则主动离开家乡。与此同时，城镇生活水平大幅提高，而农村地区获得的经济机会很少，这促使年轻人进城寻求更好的生活。

要使城乡协调发展，需要各方共同努力。有关部门应向农村倾斜更多资源，为本地就业创造有利条件，让农村居民也能从国家发展中获益。
tips: 本题是**一升一降**的经典图：首句用 did not move in a uniform direction，主体句用 climbed … while … declined。
数据只有首末两年，两句写完即可；无需 By contrast（while 已表对比）。
第二段用经济类模板，落点写"城镇化 + 经济机会不均"。
第三段若写负面倾向，可把 authorities should 换成 channel more resources into the countryside。

key_phrases.en: did not move in a uniform direction
key_phrases.cn: 并未朝着相同方向变化

key_phrases.en: climbed from … to …, while … declined from … to …
the joint effects of urbanization and unequal economic opportunities
key_phrases.cn: 城镇化与经济机会不均的共同作用

key_phrases.en: on their own initiative
channel more resources into …

2015.title: Part B 大作文：春节假期花销比例饼图
2015.apply_en:
The pie chart presents an uneven distribution among the categories associated with Spring Festival spending. Traveling, gift giving and dinners with friends or relatives account for the largest share, together making up 80% of the total. In contrast, other items make up a relatively small proportion.

Most spending is used to maintain or facilitate interpersonal relationships. This finding is not strange, since the Spring Festival is a traditional Chinese festival for family reunion. Developing relationships is beneficial and necessary for a person's fulfillment, and investing in the people we love is sweet and happy. Seen in this light, the pattern of spending is no coincidence but a natural consequence of social life.

However, we should not go to extremes. Individuals should make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances, ensuring that the festival spending genuinely contributes to their long-term well-being rather than to unnecessary comparison.
2015.apply_cn:
该饼图呈现了春节各项花销之间的不均衡分布。旅行、送礼以及与亲友聚餐占比最大，合计达总额的 80%。相比之下，其他项目占比很小。

大部分开支用于维系或增进人际关系。这并不奇怪，因为春节是中国人家庭团聚的传统节日。经营关系对个人幸福既有益又必要，为所爱之人花钱也甜蜜而快乐。由此可见，这一消费结构并非偶然，而是社会生活变化的自然结果。

然而，我们不应走极端。个人应结合自身情况作出理性选择，让节日花销真正有利于长期福祉，而非助长不必要的攀比。
tips: 饼图 + 占比分布 → 用**静态**第一段模板（accounts for the largest share / in contrast），首句 chart 前加 pie。
三项合计 80% 是本图关键，用 together making up 80% of the total 一句带过，不必分列三个百分比（图中未给全）。
第二段套经济类模板，主题落到"人情往来/人际关系"。
第三段用负面版收尾（不应攀比），与参考范文的 not go to extremes 呼应。

key_phrases.en: This pie chart presents an uneven distribution among…
key_phrases.cn: 该饼图呈现了……之间的不均衡分布

key_phrases.en: account for the largest share, together making up …% of the total
key_phrases.cn: 占比最大，合计达总额的……%

key_phrases.en: facilitate interpersonal relationships
not go to extremes
a natural consequence of social life
key_phrases.cn: 社会生活变化的自然结果

2016.title: Part B 大作文：高校学生旅游目的调查饼图
2016.apply_en:
The pie chart presents an uneven distribution among the purposes of travel for students polled in a certain university. Appreciating the beauty of the scenery accounts for the largest share, at 37%. Relieving pressure follows closely, representing 33%. In contrast, making more friends, fostering independence and other aims make up relatively small proportions of 9%, 6% and 15% respectively.

The survey reveals that most students travel to enjoy the view as well as to unwind. On the one hand, with the prosperity of tourism, college students who have ample time and curiosity are lured to explore the outside world. On the other hand, growing academic pressure makes a journey an ideal way to recharge. Seen in this light, the pattern of travel purposes is a natural consequence of campus life.

For travel to bring lasting benefits, students should make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances, ensuring that a journey genuinely contributes to their long-term development.
2016.apply_cn:
该饼图呈现了某高校受访学生旅游目的之间的不均衡分布。欣赏风景占比最大，达 37%。缓解压力紧随其后，占 33%。相比之下，广交朋友、培养独立能力及其他目的占比很小，分别为 9%、6% 和 15%。

调查显示，多数学生旅行是为欣赏风景和放松身心。一方面，随着旅游业繁荣，时间充裕、好奇心强的大学生被吸引去探索外部世界；另一方面，学业压力增大，旅行成为理想的充电方式。由此可见，这一旅游目的结构是校园生活的自然结果。

要使旅行带来长久收益，学生应结合自身情况作出理性选择，让旅程真正有利于自身长远发展。
tips: 饼图 5 项：最大的两项用完整句，其余三项合并一句带过（respectively 收尾），避免句子臃肿。
首句直接点出图型 pie chart，用静态模板的 presents an uneven distribution。
第二段套校园类模板，双因结构（旅游繁荣 / 学业压力）对应原文的两条理由。
注意 37% / 33% 是"最大两项"，写完后用 follows closely 衔接，比 next comes 更书面。

key_phrases.en: accounts for the largest share, at …%
follows closely, representing …%
make up relatively small proportions of …, respectively
with the prosperity of tourism
an ideal way to recharge

2017.title: Part B 大作文：2013-2015年博物馆数量与参观人数折线图
2017.apply_en:
The line chart shows that the figures associated with museums and museum visitors rose steadily from 2013 to 2015. The number of museums climbed from 4,169 to 4,692, while the number of visitors rose from 637 million to 954 million over the same span. Although both moved in the same direction, the growth of museums slowed down in 2014 while visits maintained a dynamic momentum.

The progress can be attributed to the following reasons. Firstly, thanks to the national endeavour in cultural undertakings, numerous museums have been built and opened free to the public. Moreover, as living standards improve, the public demand increasingly varied spiritual nourishment, and visiting museums has therefore become a willing choice for more people.

However, this encouraging sign also presents challenges. Relevant authorities should improve the supply of cultural services, so that the growth of facilities can keep pace with the public's growing demand.
2017.apply_cn:
该折线图表明，2013 至 2015 年间博物馆数量与参观人数的数据均持续上升。博物馆数量从 4169 家攀升至 4692 家，参观人数同期从 6.37 亿增至 9.54 亿。二者虽同向变动，但博物馆数量的增长在 2014 年放缓，而参观人数保持了强劲势头。

这一进步可归因于以下原因。首先，得益于国家在文化事业上的努力，大量博物馆建成并向公众免费开放。此外，随着生活水平提高，公众对多样化精神食粮的需求上升，参观博物馆因而成为更多人的自愿选择。

然而，这一可喜迹象也带来挑战。有关部门应改善文化服务供给，使设施增长能够跟上公众日益增长的需求。
tips: 折线图 + 两事物同向 → 首句用 rose steadily，**不要**用 did not move in a uniform direction。
"2014 年博物馆增速放缓、参观人数仍强劲"是本题最容易被忽略的对比，必须写。
第二段是文化类话题，用文化自信类模板的经济/文化双因（国家投入 + 生活水平）。
第三段用负面版转向"挑战（supply deficiency）"，与参考答案的 however 收尾一致。

key_phrases.en: rose steadily from … to …
maintained a dynamic momentum
the national endeavour in cultural undertakings
key_phrases.cn: 国家在文化事业上的努力

key_phrases.en: varied spiritual nourishment
keep pace with the public demand

2018.title: Part B 大作文：2017年某市消费者选择餐厅时的关注因素饼状图
2018.apply_en:
The pie chart presents an uneven distribution among the factors consumers take into account when selecting a restaurant in a certain city in 2017. Distinguishing features account for the largest share, at 36.3%. Service and environment form the middle group, representing 26.8% and 23.8% respectively. In contrast, price and other factors make up relatively small proportions of 8.4% and 4.7%.

The pattern is closely related to economic development. On the one hand, as per capita disposable income has risen, more people can afford to dine out, and it is natural that they care more about high-quality enjoyment than about price. On the other hand, an increasing number of restaurants with similar prices are available, so distinctive features have become the key to standing out. Seen in this light, the change in priorities is a natural consequence of social life.

For this trend to continue, both restaurants and consumers should act reasonably. Restaurants should improve service and environment objectively, while consumers should make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances.
2018.apply_cn:
该饼图呈现了 2017 年某市消费者选择餐厅时各关注因素之间的不均衡分布。餐厅特色占比最大，达 36.3%。服务与环境处于中间位置，分别占 26.8% 和 23.8%。相比之下，价格及其他因素占比很小，分别为 8.4% 和 4.7%。

这一格局与经济发展密切相关。一方面，随着人均可支配收入提高，更多人能够负担外出就餐，自然更看重高品质享受而非价格；另一方面，价格相近的餐厅越来越多，特色便成为脱颖而出的关键。由此可见，关注重点的转变是社会生活变化的自然结果。

要使这一趋势延续，餐厅与消费者都应理性行事。餐厅应客观提升服务与环境，消费者也应结合自身情况作出理性选择。
tips: 饼图 4+1 项：前两项完整句，中间组用 form the middle group 合并，价格与其他合并一句（In contrast 引出）。
"价格仅 8.4%，低于服务与环境"是本题的对比亮点，务必点出。
第二段用经济类模板，双因落到"可支配收入 + 同类餐厅增多"。
首句 chart 换成 pie chart，且注意题干有年份（in 2017），可写入首句。

key_phrases.en: form the middle group, representing …% and …% respectively
key_phrases.cn: 处于中间位置，分别占……% 和……%

key_phrases.en: make up relatively small proportions of … and …
per capita disposable income
the key to standing out
the change in priorities

2019.title: Part B 大作文：某高校2013年和2018年本科毕业生去向统计柱状图
2019.apply_en:
The bar chart shows that the proportions associated with graduates' choices did not move in a uniform direction from 2013 to 2018. The share of those entering employment declined from 68.1% to 60.7%, while the share of those pursuing further education climbed from 26.3% to 34.0%. By contrast, the proportion of graduates starting a business rose slightly, from 1.3% to 2.6%.

The data reflects a shift in graduates' view of post-university life. On the one hand, as the job market becomes increasingly competitive, a higher degree is widely regarded as a way of securing an advantage. On the other hand, with living standards improving, more families can afford to support further study, and the idea that one should earn a living as early as possible is changing.

For graduates to make sound decisions, efforts from both universities and students are essential. Universities should offer clearer career guidance, while students should make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances.
2019.apply_cn:
该柱状图表明，2013 至 2018 年间毕业生去向的占比并未朝着相同方向变化。就业比例从 68.1% 降至 60.7%，而升学比例从 26.3% 升至 34.0%。相比之下，创业比例略有上升，从 1.3% 升至 2.6%。

这些数据反映了毕业生对毕业后生活看法的转变。一方面，就业市场竞争日趋激烈，更高学历被普遍视为获取优势的途径；另一方面，随着生活水平提高，更多家庭能够负担继续深造，而“尽早挣钱养家”的观念正在发生变化。

要使毕业生作出合理选择，需要高校与学生共同努力。高校应提供更清晰的职业指导，学生也应结合自身情况作出理性选择。
tips: 三事物、有升有降 → 首句用 did not move in a uniform direction，主体句一降一升用 while，第三项用 By contrast 引出。
两组年份（2013 vs 2018）是本题的"时间跨度"，务必在首句标明 from 2013 to 2018。
第二段套经济类（就业市场）或校园类模板，把两条原因写清即可。
创业比例 1.3%→2.6% 属"轻微上升"，用 rose slightly，程度词不可省。

key_phrases.en: did not move in a uniform direction
key_phrases.cn: 并未朝着相同方向变化

key_phrases.en: declined from … to …, while … climbed from … to …
rose slightly
a shift in graduates’ view of post-university life
key_phrases.cn: 毕业生对毕业后生活看法的转变

key_phrases.en: secure an advantage

2020.title: Part B 大作文：某高校学生手机阅读目的调查
2020.apply_en:
The pie chart presents an uneven distribution among the purposes of mobile reading among students at a certain university. Gaining knowledge accounts for the largest share, at 59.5%. Killing time and obtaining information form the middle group, representing 21.3% and 17.0% respectively. In contrast, other purposes make up a relatively small proportion of 2.2%.

A few factors contribute to this trend. To begin with, as a nation with a booming digital economy, knowledge is increasingly available through mobile reading, which serves as a fast and convenient tool. Moreover, the awareness of self-improvement has spread widely among university students who wish to stay competitive in the job market. Seen in this light, mobile reading has become a natural choice for campus life.

For mobile reading to bring lasting benefits, students should make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances, ensuring that it genuinely contributes to their long-term development.
2020.apply_cn:
该饼图呈现了某高校学生手机阅读目的之间的不均衡分布。获取知识占比最大，达 59.5%。消磨时间与获取信息处于中间位置，分别占 21.3% 和 17.0%。相比之下，其他目的占比很小，仅 2.2%。

若干因素促成了这一趋势。首先，在数字经济蓬勃发展的国家，知识越来越容易通过手机阅读获取，手机成为快速便捷的工具。此外，希望在就业市场保持竞争力的学生中，自我提升意识已广泛传播。由此可见，手机阅读已成为校园生活的自然选择。

要使手机阅读带来长久收益，学生应结合自身情况作出理性选择，让它真正有利于自身长远发展。
tips: 饼图 4 项、占比差距大（59.5% vs 2.2%）→ 用静态模板：最大项完整句 + 中间组合并 + 最小项 In contrast 收尾。
"获取知识"占近六成是本题的主旨指向（正面），第二段因此写"自我提升"而非"浪费时间"。
第二段套校园类模板，双因：数字经济发展 + 竞争意识。
末段用正面版，落在 make well-informed choices。

key_phrases.en: accounts for the largest share, at …%
form the middle group, representing …% and …% respectively
key_phrases.cn: 处于中间位置，分别占……% 和……%

key_phrases.en: make up a relatively small proportion of …%
stay competitive in the job market
key_phrases.cn: 在就业市场中保持竞争力

key_phrases.en: the awareness of self-improvement

2021.title: Part B 大作文：某市居民锻炼方式调查
2021.apply_en:
The bar chart presents an uneven distribution among the exercise methods chosen by residents in a certain city. Working out alone accounts for the largest share, at slightly over half of the respondents. Exercising with friends follows closely, representing 47.7%, while working out with family members accounts for 23.9%. In contrast, playing team sports makes up a relatively small proportion of less than 16%.

People prefer to exercise alone primarily on account of flexibility and convenience. In this way, they can go jogging anytime they want, without the need to make a plan with others in advance. Furthermore, a wide range of fitness videos, apps and games have boosted the popularity of doing workouts at home. Seen in this light, the popularity of independent exercise is a natural consequence of changing lifestyles.

For physical exercise to bring lasting benefits, individuals should make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances, while relevant authorities should provide more public sports facilities.
2021.apply_cn:
该柱状图呈现了某市居民锻炼方式之间的不均衡分布。独自锻炼占比最大，略超受访者半数。与朋友一起锻炼紧随其后，占 47.7%，与家人一起锻炼占 23.9%。相比之下，参加团体活动占比很小，不足 16%。

人们偏好独自锻炼，主要出于灵活与便利。这样他们可以随时去跑步，无需提前与他人约定。此外，大量健身视频、应用与游戏也推动了居家独自锻炼的流行。由此可见，独立锻炼的流行是生活方式变化的自然结果。

要使体育锻炼带来长久收益，个人应结合自身情况作出理性选择，有关部门也应提供更多公共体育设施。
tips: "超过半数"没有精确数字，用 slightly over half of the respondents，不要臆造百分比。
四项中前三项递减、末项骤降 → 前三句并列，末项用 In contrast 收尾。
第二段套体育健康类模板（或环境类换词），双因：灵活便利 + 居家健身资源。
"独自 > 与朋友 > 与家人 > 团体"的排序本身就是题眼，句式要体现递降关系。

key_phrases.en: accounts for the largest share, at slightly over half of the respondents
key_phrases.cn: 占比最大，略超受访者半数

key_phrases.en: follows closely, representing …%
on account of flexibility and convenience
boosted the popularity of doing workouts at home
key_phrases.cn: 推动了居家锻炼的流行

key_phrases.en: public sports facilities

2022.title: Part B 大作文：2018—2020年我国快递业务量变动情况
2022.apply_en:
The bar chart shows that the express delivery volumes associated with the whole country and rural areas rose steadily from 2018 to 2020. The national volume climbed from 51 billion pieces to 83 billion pieces, while the rural volume rose from 12 billion to 30 billion over the same span. Although both moved in the same direction, the growth in rural areas was particularly striking.

The robust growth is closely tied to the e-commerce boom. To be specific, as livestreaming e-commerce takes off, people are more inclined to purchase online, thereby giving impetus to the delivery business. Moreover, the government has made sustained efforts to improve infrastructure in the countryside, which paves the way for courier services to extend to the vast rural markets. Seen in this light, the surge is a natural consequence of economic change.

For this trend to continue, both enterprises and authorities should act reasonably. Enterprises should improve efficiency and service quality, while authorities should keep upgrading rural logistics.
2022.apply_cn:
该柱状图表明，2018 至 2020 年间全国与农村的快递业务量均持续上升。全国业务量从 510 亿件攀升至 830 亿件，农村同期从 120 亿件增至 300 亿件。二者虽同向变动，但农村地区的增长尤为显著。

这一强劲增长与电商繁荣密切相关。具体而言，随着直播电商兴起，人们更倾向线上购物，从而推动快递业务发展。此外，政府持续改善农村基础设施，为快递服务延伸到广阔的农村市场铺平了道路。由此可见，这一激增是经济变化的自然结果。

要使这一趋势延续，企业与政府都应理性行事。企业应提升效率与服务质量，政府则应持续升级农村物流。
tips: 两事物同向、幅度不同 → 首句 rose steadily，用 while 并列两个上升，末句用 the growth in rural areas was particularly striking 点题。
"农村翻倍"是题眼：用 doubled 或 the growth was particularly striking 强调。
第二段套经济类模板，双因：直播电商 + 农村基础设施。
数字单位是 billion pieces（十亿件），注意与原文单位一致。

key_phrases.en: rose steadily from … to …
the trend is particularly striking
as livestreaming e-commerce takes off
paves the way for …
give impetus to the delivery business

2023.title: Part B 大作文：2012—2021年我国居民健康素养水平变化趋势
2023.apply_en:
The line chart shows that the health literacy rate of Chinese residents rose steadily from 2012 to 2021. The figure climbed from 8.80% in 2012 to 25.40% in 2021, showing a steady upward trend. Notably, the year 2016 marked a watershed, when the growth accelerated considerably.

A few factors contribute to this progress. To begin with, as general living standards and educational levels improve, residents become more aware of their health and start to seek various ways to stay healthy. Secondly, the digitalization of many health services, such as online consultation and AI diagnosis, has enabled residents to gain easy and fast access to professional advice. Moreover, government campaigns to promote public hygiene have also played a part.

For this trend to continue, both authorities and individuals should act reasonably. Authorities should keep improving medical services, while individuals should make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances.
2023.apply_cn:
该折线图表明，2012 至 2021 年间中国居民健康素养水平持续上升。该数值从 2012 年的 8.80% 攀升至 2021 年的 25.40%，呈现稳定上升趋势。值得注意的是，2016 年是转折点，增速明显加快。

若干因素促成了这一进步。首先，随着整体生活水平与教育水平提高，居民健康意识增强，开始寻求多种保持健康的方式。其次，在线问诊、AI 诊断等健康服务的数字化，使居民能够便捷快速地获得专业建议。此外，政府推动公共卫生的宣传活动也发挥了作用。

要使这一趋势延续，政府与个人都应理性行事。政府应持续改善医疗服务，个人也应结合自身情况作出理性选择。
tips: 折线图、单线持续升 → 一条上升线写到底，配 showing a steady upward trend，**不要**写对比句。
"2016 年是转折点、增速加快"是本题唯一的结构信息，用 marked a watershed when … accelerated considerately 写出。
第二段套体育健康类模板，三因：生活水平 / 数字医疗 / 政府宣传。
百分比要带两位小数（8.80% / 25.40%），与图表一致。

key_phrases.en: rose steadily from … to …
showing a steady upward trend
marked a watershed when the growth accelerated
gain easy and fast access to professional advice
key_phrases.cn: 便捷快速地获得专业建议

key_phrases.en: health literacy rate

2024.title: Part B 大作文：某高校劳动实践课学生主要收获调查（柱状图）
2024.apply_en:
The bar chart presents an uneven distribution among the benefits students gained from labor practice courses at a certain university. Gaining relevant knowledge accounts for the largest share, at 91.3%. Improving practical ability follows closely, representing 84.8%. In contrast, obtaining cheerful moods and enhancing cooperative ability make up relatively small proportions of 54.4% and 32.6% respectively.

The chart reflects the university's tendency in course design to provide knowledge and foster practical ability. This can be attributed to the following aspects. Firstly, the practical knowledge offered by the course enables students to better understand their interests and paves the way for their career development. Moreover, hands-on experience is highly valued in today's job market, which encourages students to focus on applicable skills.

For labor practice courses to play a greater role, universities should keep improving the curriculum, while students should make well-informed choices in light of their own needs.
2024.apply_cn:
该柱状图呈现了某高校学生从劳动实践课中所得收获之间的不均衡分布。获得相关知识占比最大，达 91.3%。提升实践能力紧随其后，占 84.8%。相比之下，获得愉悦心情与增强合作能力占比相对较小，分别为 54.4% 和 32.6%。

该图反映了高校在课程设计中提供知识、培养实践能力的倾向。这可归因于以下方面。首先，课程提供的实用知识使学生更好地了解自身兴趣，为职业发展铺路；此外，实践经历在当今就业市场备受重视，促使学生关注可应用技能。

要使劳动实践课发挥更大作用，高校应持续改进课程，学生也应结合自身需求作出理性选择。
tips: 柱状图、占比分布 → 静态模板：最大项 + 紧随项 + In contrast 收尾的两项。
"知识 91.3% / 实践 84.8%"两项都超八成，是本题的"高占比组"，与前两名的表述要连贯。
第二段套校园类模板，双因：课程设计 + 就业市场需求。
注意题干的 gains 是"收获"，第二段解释"为什么这些收获被认可"。

key_phrases.en: accounts for the largest share, at …%
follows closely, representing …%
make up relatively small proportions of …% and …% respectively
key_phrases.cn: 占比相对较小，分别为……% 和……%

key_phrases.en: paves the way for their career development
hands-on experience

2025.title: Part B 大作文：某社区老年人主要日常休闲活动调查（柱形图）
2025.apply_en:
The bar chart presents an uneven distribution among the leisure activities of the elderly in a certain community. Watching television accounts for the largest share, at 90.8%. Taking walks follows closely, representing 68.3%. In contrast, planting flowers, reading and playing chess make up relatively small proportions of 34.7%, 31.8% and 18.4% respectively.

The differences reflect the living conditions and needs of the elderly. First of all, watching television is an extremely convenient way to obtain information and enjoy entertainment, which explains why the vast majority choose it. Secondly, walking is a low-intensity activity suitable for most elderly people. Besides, although planting flowers, reading and playing chess occupy smaller shares, they still enrich the daily life of those who take them up.

For the elderly to enjoy a better life, both communities and families should act reasonably. Communities should offer more recreational facilities, while families should care about the elderly's real needs.
2025.apply_cn:
该柱状图呈现了某社区老年人日常休闲活动之间的不均衡分布。看电视占比最大，达 90.8%。散步紧随其后，占 68.3%。相比之下，养花、阅读与下棋占比相对较小，分别为 34.7%、31.8% 和 18.4%。

这些差异反映了老年人的生活条件与需求。首先，看电视是获取信息、享受娱乐的极便捷方式，这解释了为何绝大多数人选择它；其次，散步是适合多数老年人的低强度活动。此外，养花、阅读与下棋虽占比较小，仍丰富了参与者的日常生活。

要让老年人享有更好的生活，社区与家庭都应理性行事。社区应提供更多休闲设施，家庭应关心老年人的真实需求。
tips: 柱状图 5 项：两项高占比完整句，三项低占比合并且用 respectively 收尾。
首句 chart 换 bar chart，用 present an uneven distribution 起头最稳。
第二段套体育健康类（或社会生活）模板，分述"便捷"与"低强度"两条原因。
"低占比项也丰富了生活"是加分点——避免只写正向、忽略次要数据。

key_phrases.en: accounts for the largest share, at …%
follows closely, representing …%
make up relatively small proportions of …, … and … respectively
key_phrases.cn: 占比相对较小，分别为……、……和……

key_phrases.en: a low-intensity activity suitable for the elderly
key_phrases.cn: 适合老年人的低强度活动

key_phrases.en: enrich the daily life

2026.title: 图表作文：儿童户外活动的益处
2026.apply_en:
The bar chart presents an uneven distribution among the perceived benefits of children's outdoor activities. Satisfying curiosity accounts for the largest share, at 54.6%. Enhancing observation skills follows closely, representing 54.5%. In contrast, improving physical fitness and strengthening parent-child interaction make up relatively smaller proportions of 37.2% and 33.2% respectively.

The findings are closely linked to rising public awareness of children's all-round development. On the one hand, the high value placed on curiosity and observation suggests that parents increasingly regard the outdoor world as a vivid classroom where children learn through discovery. On the other hand, as daily life becomes more sedentary, outdoor activities serve as a practical way to build physical fitness and tighten family bonds. Seen in this light, the pattern of opinions is a natural consequence of changing parenting ideas.

For children to benefit more from outdoor activities, both families and schools should act reasonably. Families should set aside regular time for outdoor play, while schools should design more activity-based courses.
2026.apply_cn:
该柱状图呈现了人们对儿童户外活动各项益处看法之间的不均衡分布。满足好奇心占比最大，达 54.6%。促进观察力紧随其后，占 54.5%。相比之下，强身健体与增强亲子互动占比相对较小，分别为 37.2% 和 33.2%。

调查结果与公众对儿童全面发展意识的提高密切相关。一方面，人们对好奇心与观察力的高度重视表明，家长日益把户外世界视为孩子通过探索来学习的生动课堂；另一方面，随着日常生活愈发久坐化，户外活动成为强健体魄、密切亲子关系的实用途径。由此可见，这一看法格局是育儿观念变化的自然结果。

要让孩子从户外活动中获益更多，家庭与学校都应理性行事。家庭应留出固定的户外活动时间，学校应设计更多以活动为主的课程。
tips: 柱状图 4 项、两项相近（54.6% / 54.5%）→ 前两项并列，后两项用 In contrast 合并。
"人们看法"类图表（survey）第二段用校园类/体育健康类模板，落点写"全面发展 + 育儿观念"。
注意题干是 people's views，写原因时要写"家长/公众为什么这样认为"，而非"儿童为什么喜欢户外"。
数字若与官方图有出入，以考场原图为准，本示范按 54.6 / 54.5 / 37.2 / 33.2 撰写。

key_phrases.en: presents an uneven distribution among the perceived benefits of …
key_phrases.cn: 呈现了人们对……各项益处的看法分布

key_phrases.en: accounts for the largest share, at …%
follows closely, representing …%
regard … as a vivid classroom where children learn through discovery
key_phrases.cn: 把……视为孩子通过探索来学习的生动课堂

key_phrases.en: a natural consequence of changing parenting ideas
key_phrases.cn: 育儿观念变化的自然结果
